        Check if this item cost can be met from the player's inventory and zero or more supplementary inventories.
        Parameters:
        player - the player to check
        playerFirst - true if the player's inventory should be checked before the extra inventories
        extraInventories - zero or more Inventory objects
        Returns:
        true if the cost can be met; false otherwise

                  org.bukkit.entity.Player player,
                  boolean playerFirst,
                  org.bukkit.inventory.Inventory... extraInventories)
        Apply this cost to the given player plus zero or more supplementary inventories.
        Parameters:
        player - the player to give or take items from
        playerFirst - if true, then the player's inventory will be modified first
        extraInventories - zero or more supplementary inventories to give or take items from
